# R Setup

# Load necessary libraries
library(Rilostat)

# Part 1: Importing data with R packages

## Female labour force participation (ILO)

**1.** We selected "Labour force participation rate by sex and age"
(`EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A`). It measures the labour force as a percentage
of the population in the corresponding sex and age group. We focus on
women aged 45–54. Among the matching annual series in the ILOSTAT
catalogue, this dataset has the earliest starting year (1946), whereas
the ILO modelled series (`EAP_2WAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A`) starts in 1990 and
`EAP_5WAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A` only in 2014.

**2.**

```{r}
# Search for labour force participation datasets
toc <- get_ilostat_toc(
  search = "Labour force participation",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Compare the annual series by sex and age
toc[
  toc$id %in% c(
    "EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A",
    "EAP_2WAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A",
    "EAP_5WAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A"
  ),
  c("id", "data.start", "data.end")
]
```

```{r}
# Import data for women aged 45–54, for all countries
df_ilo <- get_ilostat(
  id = "EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A",
  type = "code",
  time_format = "num",
  filters = list(
    sex = "SEX_F",
    classif1 = "AGE_10YRBANDS_Y45-54",
    timefrom = 1950,
    timeto = 2025
  ),
  best_source = "all",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Check the available years
min(df_ilo$time)
max(df_ilo$time)
```

## GDP per capita (World Bank)

**1.** We chose the indicator `NY.GDP.PCAP.KD`, because it contains
observations dating back to 1960, is measured in the same currency for
all countries and is adjusted for inflation (2015 US\$).

**2.**

```{r}
toc_wdi <- WDIsearch('gdp.*capita.*US')
print(toc_wdi)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(toc_wdi))){
  pointer <- WDI(indicator=toc_wdi[i,1], end=2025)
  first_year <- min(pointer$year)
  number_of_rows <- nrow(pointer)
  ncountries <- length(unique(pointer$country))
  cat("Indicator", toc_wdi[i,1], "dates back to", first_year, "and contains", number_of_rows, "observations from", ncountries, "georaphic areas.\n")
}

gdp_per_capita <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator="NY.GDP.PCAP.KD", 
  end=2025
  )
```
